name: Ensured Governance Framework Setting and Maintenance
description: Analyze and articulate the requirements for the governance of enterprise I&T, and put in place and maintain effective governance structures, principles and practices.
purpose: Provide a consistent approach integrated and aligned with the enterprise governance approach to evaluate, direct and monitor I&T.

name: Ensured Benefits Delivery
description: Optimize the business value contribution from business processes, I&T services and I&T assets resulting from investments.
purpose: Secure optimal value from I&T-enabled initiatives, services and assets.

name: Ensured Risk Optimization
description: Ensure that the enterprise's risk appetite and tolerance are understood, articulated and communicated, and that risk to enterprise value related to the use of I&T is identified and managed.
purpose: Ensure that enterprise value is not degraded by I&T-related risk.

name: Ensured Resource Optimization
description: Ensure that adequate and sufficient I&T-related capabilities (people, process and technology) are available to support enterprise objectives.
purpose: Ensure that the resource needs of the enterprise are met in the optimal manner.

name: Ensured Stakeholder Engagement
description: Ensure that stakeholder reporting and communication are effective, timely and transparent and that stakeholders are engaged appropriately.
purpose: Ensure that stakeholders are supportive of the I&T strategy and roadmaps.

name: Managed I&T Management Framework
description: Design the management system for enterprise I&T based on enterprise goals and other design factors.
purpose: Implement a consistent management approach for enterprise I&T to meet governance requirements.

name: Managed Strategy
description: Provide a holistic view of the current business and IT environment, the future direction, and the initiatives required to migrate to the desired future environment.
purpose: Support the enterprise digital transformation strategy and secure desired value.

name: Managed Enterprise Architecture
description: Establish a common architecture consisting of business, information, data, application and technology architecture layers.
purpose: Represent the different building blocks and their relationships to guide efficient technology implementation.

name: Managed Innovation
description: Maintain an awareness of information technology and related service trends to identify innovation opportunities.
purpose: Achieve competitive advantage, business innovation, and improved customer experience.

name: Managed Portfolio
description: Execute the strategic direction set for investments in line with enterprise architecture and investment criteria.
purpose: Optimize the performance of the overall portfolio of enterprise programs and projects.

name: Managed Budget and Costs
description: Manage I&T-related financial activities in both the business and IT functions, covering budget, cost and benefit management.
purpose: Foster a partnership between IT and business stakeholders to enable effective and efficient use of I&T resources.

name: Managed Human Resources
description: Optimize human resources capabilities to meet enterprise objectives.
purpose: Acquire, develop and retain skilled, competent and motivated personnel.

name: Managed Relationships
description: Manage the relationship between the business and I&T in a formalized and transparent way.
purpose: Create improved outcomes, better engagement and alignment between IT and business.

name: Managed Service Agreements
description: Align I&T-enabled services and service levels with enterprise needs and expectations.
purpose: Ensure that I&T services and service levels meet current and future enterprise needs.

name: Managed Vendors
description: Manage I&T-related services provided by all types of external vendors to meet enterprise requirements.
purpose: Optimize vendor performance and minimize vendor risk.

name: Managed Quality
description: Define and communicate quality requirements in all processes, procedures and related enterprise I&T outcomes.
purpose: Ensure continuous delivery of technology solutions and services that meet quality expectations.

name: Managed Risk
description: Continually identify, assess and reduce I&T-related risk within levels of tolerance set by enterprise executive management.
purpose: Integrate the management of I&T-related enterprise risk with overall enterprise risk management.

name: Managed Security
description: Define, operate and monitor a system for information security management.
purpose: Keep the impact and occurrence of information security incidents within the enterprise's risk appetite.

name: Managed Data
description: Achieve and sustain effective management of the enterprise data assets across the data lifecycle.
purpose: Ensure effective utilization of critical data assets to achieve enterprise goals.

name: Managed Programs
description: Manage all programs from the investment portfolio in alignment with enterprise strategy and in a coordinated way.
purpose: Realize business benefits and reduce the risk of delays and costs by coordinating program initiatives.

name: Managed Requirements Definition
description: Identify solutions and analyze requirements before acquisition or creation to ensure alignment with strategic requirements.
purpose: Create or acquire optimal solutions that meet enterprise needs and minimize risk.

name: Managed Solutions Identification and Build
description: Establish and maintain identified solutions in accordance with enterprise requirements covering design, development and sourcing.
purpose: Ensure agile and scalable delivery of digital products and services.

name: Managed Availability and Capacity
description: Balance current and future needs for availability, performance and capacity with cost-effective service provision.
purpose: Maintain service capability that is aligned with business requirements.

name: Managed Organizational Change
description: Prepare and commit stakeholders for business change and manage the change effectively.
purpose: Maximize the likelihood of successfully implementing sustainable enterprise-wide organizational change.

name: Managed IT Changes
description: Manage all changes in a controlled manner, including standard changes and emergency maintenance relating to business processes and IT.
purpose: Enable fast and reliable delivery of change to the business while mitigating risk of negative impacts.

name: Managed IT Change Acceptance and Transitioning
description: Formally accept and make operational new solutions, including implementation planning, conversion and post-implementation review.
purpose: Successfully transition solutions into the live environment.

name: Managed Knowledge
description: Maintain the availability of relevant, current, validated and reliable knowledge to support all process activities.
purpose: Enable informed decision making and improved productivity through shared knowledge assets.

name: Managed Assets
description: Manage the asset lifecycle of all I&T assets to maximize value, optimize costs and mitigate risk.
purpose: Ensure that enterprise assets are utilized effectively, accounted for, and safeguarded.

name: Managed Configuration
description: Define and maintain descriptions and relationships between key resources and capabilities required to deliver I&T-enabled services.
purpose: Provide sufficient information about service assets to enable the service to be managed effectively.

name: Managed Projects
description: Manage all projects initiated within the enterprise in alignment with enterprise strategy and in a coordinated way.
purpose: Deliver defined project outcomes within agreed upon parameters.

name: Managed Operations
description: Coordinate and execute the activities and operational procedures required to deliver internal and outsourced I&T services.
purpose: Deliver I&T operational service outcomes as planned.

name: Managed Service Requests and Incidents
description: Provide timely and effective response to user requests and resolution of all types of incidents.
purpose: Achieve increased productivity and minimize disruptions through quick resolution of user queries and incidents.

name: Managed Problems
description: Identify and classify problems and their root causes, and provide timely resolution to prevent recurring incidents.
purpose: Increase availability, improve service levels, reduce costs, and improve customer satisfaction.

name: Managed Continuity
description: Establish and maintain a plan to enable the business and IT to respond to incidents and disruptions in order to continue operation.
purpose: Adapt rapidly, continue operations, and maintain availability of resources and information at acceptable levels.

name: Managed Security Services
description: Protect enterprise information to maintain the level of information security risk acceptable to the enterprise.
purpose: Minimize the business impact of operational information security vulnerabilities and incidents.

name: Managed Business Process Controls
description: Define and maintain appropriate business process controls to ensure that information related to and processed by business processes satisfies integrity requirements.
purpose: Maintain the integrity of information and the security of information assets handled within business processes.

name: Managed Performance and Conformance Monitoring
description: Collect, validate and evaluate enterprise and I&T performance and conformance metrics and targets.
purpose: Provide transparency of performance and conformance and drive achievement of goals.

name: Managed System of Internal Control
description: Continuously monitor and evaluate the control environment, including self-assessments and independent assurance reviews.
purpose: Obtain transparency for key stakeholders on the adequacy of the system of internal controls.

name: Managed Compliance with External Requirements
description: Evaluate that I&T processes and I&T-supported business processes are compliant with laws, regulations and contractual requirements.
purpose: Ensure that the enterprise is compliant with all applicable external requirements.

name: Managed Assurance
description: Plan, scope and execute assurance initiatives to provide independent feedback on I&T governance and management.
purpose: Enable organizations to design and develop efficient and effective assurance initiatives.
